tier_1_sec_full.coverage: US public + ADRs foreign filers on US exchanges
tier_1_sec_full.fields_rich: 503 us-gaap concepts (Revenues, Assets, NetIncomeLoss, etc) + dei, 10-K 10-Q 8-K filing history
tier_1_sec_full.credibility: Highest - regulatory mandated, audited, XBRL structured

tier_2_global_public.source: Yahoo Finance / MSCI ACWI IMI ~8000-9000 + Dimensional ~13000 investable universe
tier_2_global_public.coverage: Developed ex-US + emerging markets public listings, Bloomberg global 33k listed 1995-2016 growth
tier_2_global_public.api: yfinance + OpenCorporates jurisdiction mapping, SEC foreign 20-F for cross-listed
tier_2_global_public.fields: price ret_1M/3M/6M/12M vol_30D market_cap (limited XBRL via ifrs-full taxonomy)
tier_2_global_public.credibility: High for price, Medium for fundamentals (IFRS varies by country)

tier_3_private_firmographics.source: OpenCorporates 84M+ companies 100+ jurisdictions + GLEIF LEI 2.5M + Companies House UK 5M
tier_3_private_firmographics.coverage: Private companies world - name, address, incorporation date, status, officers, SIC/NAICS where available
tier_3_private_firmographics.api: opencorporates.com API (ODbL share-alike) + GLEIF LEI v2 golden copy + companydatacom/public-datasets city samples
tier_3_private_firmographics.fields: firmographic only: revenue USD est (sparse), employees, founding_year, headquarter linkage, industry code
tier_3_private_firmographics.credibility: Medium - scraped from national registries, structured but not audited
tier_3_private_firmographics.use: Sector embedding, address geo, size proxy, private co coverage for holistic map

tier_4_gov_stats.source: US Census Bureau CBP, BLS QCEW, BEA, FRED, World Bank
tier_4_gov_stats.coverage: Sector baselines - employment, payroll, establishment counts, macro scaffolding
tier_4_gov_stats.use: Fill gaps where firm-level sparse, provide sector anchor for normalization

holistic_goal: From 500 tickers (4831 FYs) to 10k SEC full (est 70k-100k FYs 2015-2024) to 23k investable public global to 84M entity graph for map context
